response.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM rates) AS rate_vs_mean FROM rates

assumptions.assumption: Media types are grouped by MediaTypeId (with Name), so each media type counts once even if names repeat. Only media types having at least one track appear and are included in the mean (inner join drops unmatched tracks and media types with no tracks).
Tracks with NULL Bytes are ignored in the Bytes sum by SUM, but their Milliseconds still count in the denominator.
The sum is cast to REAL to force non-integer division (SQLite-style); no rounding applied.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude tracks with NULL Bytes from both numerator and denominator, so the rate only uses tracks with known Bytes.
alternatives.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM rates) AS rate_vs_mean FROM rates
